video_title: Jeanie Buss vs. Her Siblings⁉️ Inside the Lakers Ownership Drama 👀

quotes.speaker: D'Marco Farr
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeanie Buss's decision to bring LeBron James to the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: You made the decision to sell to Mark Walter. You made that decision.

text_blocks.speaker: D'Marco Farr
text_blocks.text: Jeanie, why are you doing this? Other than you just don't want your brothers and sisters to win. You made the decision to sell to Mark Walter. You made that decision. For whatever reason, whether it's Ireland says she got an offer she couldn't refuse or I may say that you just had to escape from LeBron James and that business because he had taken your business for his own. And by the way, you knew that when you signed up. The minute you signed up to bring LeBron James to the Lakers, you knew if you wanted to pretend that the brand was bigger than LeBron, it wasn't.

quotes.speaker: D'Marco Farr
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of LeBron James on the Lakers' brand identity
quotes.excerpt: It no longer was once you let LeBron bring in Russell Westbrook, once you drafted his son.
quotes.quote: As much as we all want to believe that the Lakers are bigger than LeBron, it no longer was once you let LeBron bring in Russell Westbrook, once you drafted his son, once you made those decisions. So you ultimately had to escape, and I believe sold it because there was somebody in Mark Walter who was going to continue the legacy.

quotes.speaker: D'Marco Farr
quotes.summary_phrase: The Lakers' front office and scouting expectations under Dr. Buss
quotes.excerpt: The Lakers are now going to have the front office, they're going to have the scouting.
quotes.quote: Everything he did with the Dodgers, the Lakers are now going to have the front office. They're going to have the scouting. I remember when the ring ceremony to begin this season, it was an hour to bring out the non-players, just the coaches, the trainers, the psychologists, all this. That was going to come to the Lakers, and that's what Dr. Buss would have wanted.

quotes.speaker: D'Marco Farr
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeanie Buss's lifelong devotion to the Lakers organization
quotes.excerpt: Her entire life has been devoted to this team.
quotes.quote: Her entire life has been devoted to this team. Her relationship with her father is impossible to untangle from her relationship with the Lakers. Her relationship to the city is impossible to untangle without the Lakers. She has talked about the players being like her kids, these teams being like her kids. She has grown up in the shadow of the Los Angeles Lakers.

quotes.speaker: Travis Rodgers
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of the Iger and Kushner deal on the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Now that Iger and Kushner come in and buy the team and now that perfect marriage is no longer there.
quotes.quote: This sale comes down where Iger and Kushner come in and buy the team and now that perfect marriage is no longer there. Now she's looking around like, am I going to be here? Am I not going to be here? And I thought that Bob Iger's quote about whether or not she was going to stay on was terribly ominous.

quotes.speaker: D'Marco Farr
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA owners' perspective on the Lakers' internal ownership drama
quotes.excerpt: I don't think Adam Silver or any of the other NBA owners want this nonsense.
quotes.quote: I don't think Adam Silver or any of the other NBA owners want this nonsense. They don't want this being the headline. It's family attacking family. Is that what Dr. Buss wanted?

quotes.speaker: Travis Rodgers
quotes.summary_phrase: The implications of ceding controlling interest in an NBA team
quotes.excerpt: The second you let somebody have controlling interest of something, it's no, you don't get an opinion anymore.
quotes.quote: The second you let somebody have controlling interest of something, it's no, you don't get an opinion anymore. Factor in what Ireland said about the people she hired. So she's got five years to shepherd those people to make sure they're fine and then exit slowly on your terms.

quotes.speaker: D'Marco Farr
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeanie Buss's struggle to maintain control as governor
quotes.excerpt: She's trying to remain the governor. She's trying to remain on the team.
quotes.quote: She's trying to remain the governor. She's trying to remain on the team. It's time to let it go. You made that first decision. Now, you didn't think that it would play out this way with Mark Walter, and I don't think anybody realized that he had a fraud probe.

quotes.speaker: Travis Rodgers
quotes.summary_phrase: The history of internal conflict within the Buss family
quotes.excerpt: She blew out her brother Jim, she's had various alliances with different siblings at different times.
quotes.quote: She and her siblings have had a million laps around the track when it came to me trying to bury you and vice versa. She blew out her brother Jim, she's had various alliances with different siblings at different times in order to leverage the way that she wanted to have these things leveraged. And then, apparently, by most reports, when she sold to the Walter group, there was a group of the siblings like, we don't want to do that.

quotes.speaker: D'Marco Farr
quotes.summary_phrase: The Buss family's legacy and the decision to sell
quotes.excerpt: Would Dr. Buss have wanted you to fire his kids, your siblings?
quotes.quote: So much of the Lakers and this town are about the Buss family. And she has been the one to evoke her father's name so many times of, my father, Dr. Buss. Would Dr. Buss have wanted you to fire his kids, your siblings? Would he have wanted you to sell the team? You don't need to sell the team.
